== Biography ==
William Andersone, son of [[Anderson-3488|William Andersone]] and [[Crocket-53|Margarat Crokit]] was baptised in the parish of Alloa, Clackmannanshire on 10 April 1632.<ref>OPR Baptism indexes; ANDERSONE, WILLIAM; WILLIAM ANDERSONE/MARGARAT CROKIT FR56 (FR56); M; 10/04/1632; 465/ 10 102; Alloa; from www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk</ref>

=== Name ===
: Name:  William /ANDERSON/<ref>Source: [[#S-2050775427]]  Page:  Ancestry Family Trees Data:   Text:  http://trees.ancestry.com/pt/AMTCitationRedir.aspx?tid=13232476&pid=39363581</ref>

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns William Anderson. The banns/marriage index records Agnas Glasgow and William Anderson on 5 July 1666 at Longformacus.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 750/10 / 79; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
